title: centaurea nissana f. orbelica
intro: Centaurea nissana f. orbelica, commonly known as Mountain Centaury or Balkan Centaury, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to alleviate stress, anxiety, and insomnia due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea nissana f. orbelica include its sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as insomnia, anxiety disorders, and inflammation-related issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
